text:
elaine-b: seeing a bunch of GPU node provisioning jobs fail with 'temporary failure in name resolution' during apt pulls and k8s node-probe hitting registry.internal.svc.cluster.local

rajiv: can you paste the exact error and node logs? is it happening across zones?

elaine-b: happening in eu-west and us-east. root error from sidecar: "getaddrinfo: Name or service not known". kubelet shows DNS timeout: `lookup registry.internal.svc.cluster.local: no such host`

marco: curious — are these nodes using systemd-resolved stub (/etc/resolv.conf -> /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf)? we've seen glibc + mdns NOTFOUND short-circuit in the past

elaine-b: yes, resolved is enabled on those AMIs. /etc/nsswitch.conf on one node: `hosts: files mdns4_minimal [NOTFOUND=return] dns myhostname`

rajiv: that `[NOTFOUND=return]` can stop a DNS lookup from happening if mdns returns notfound. can you run `getent hosts registry.internal.svc.cluster.local` and `nslookup registry.internal.svc.cluster.local 127.0.0.53` on an affected node?

elaine-b: pasted outputs: 
```
$ getent hosts registry.internal.svc.cluster.local
# <no output>
$ nslookup registry.internal.svc.cluster.local 127.0.0.53
;; connection timed out; no servers could be reached
```

marco: so systemd-resolved's stub (127.0.0.53) appears overloaded / dropping queries during the burst of parallel DNS requests from provisioning. glibc's mdns4_minimal then returns NOTFOUND and because of the `[NOTFOUND=return]` the resolver doesn't fall back to DNS. result: intermittent failures only during high-concurrency GPU pool boot.

sre-bot: alert: node/gpu-pool-12 high DNS latency spike 2026-03-17T14:02Z (x12 nodes)

ops-bot: logs show repeated TCP RSTs to 127.0.0.53 and systemd-resolved under pressure on those AMIs

rajiv: quick mitigations to try: 1) point /etc/resolv.conf to cluster DNS (coredns IP) instead of the stub resolver, 2) remove `[NOTFOUND=return]` or reorder nsswitch to `files dns myhostname`, 3) deploy node-local-dns cache on GPU pools to absorb bursts.

elaine-b: confirmed — after replacing resolv.conf on one node to use the cluster coredns IP the provisioning completed. rolling that change to the pool now.

marco: long-term we should: bake AMIs without mdns plugin for GPU nodes, add node-local-dns for GPU pools, and tune systemd-resolved RateLimit/Cache settings if we keep it. i'll file a follow-up RFC.

elaine-b: filing infra ticket with logs + suggested AMI change and rollout plan. thanks :thumbsup:
